answer: In this PoA design, reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service rather than a brief burst of activity. EigenTrust matrix factorization, refined by reciprocity-weighted transitivity, gives freshly spawned Sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; lacking trusted incoming mass, they cannot pass consensus. The prism, basalt, and pearl labels add no evidentiary weight to this barrier.
